rows.note: Use this for a scheduled period of work or the workers assigned to it.
Use this as the all-purpose noun for a change or shift in a situation, such as the political atmosphere.

example.english: The market has seen a big shift lately.
example.jyutping: ni1 paai4 go3 si5 fong3 bin3 faa3 hou2 daai6

rows.note: Use this for shifting your body or position slightly, often with 一下 in speech.

example.english: Shift your position a little first.
example.jyutping: nei5 juk1 jat1 haa5 go3 wai2 sin1

rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose verb for moving or transferring physical things from one place to another.

example.english: We need to shift some goods to the warehouse.
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 bun1 di1 fo3 heoi3 cong1 fu3

rows.note: Use this when shifting an approach, form, character, or other nonphysical aspect.

example.english: We need to shift our strategy to catch up with our opponent.
example.traditional: 我哋要改變策略，先可以追到對手。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 goi2 bin3 caak3 loek6 sin1 ho2 ji5 zeoi1 dou3 deoi3 sau2

rows.note: Use this specifically for a vehicle's gear lever or stick shift, rather than a general change.

example.english: The gear shift in this car is really hard to move.
example.jyutping: ni1 gaa3 ce1 go3 bo1 gwan3 hou2 naan4 teoi1

rows.note: Use this specifically when changing gears in a vehicle.

example.english: You need to shift gears when driving uphill, or the car will not have enough power.
example.traditional: 揸車上斜嗰陣要轉波，唔係部車會冇力。
example.jyutping: zaa1 ce1 soeng5 ce4 go2 zan6 jiu3 zyun3 bo1 m4 hai6 bou6 ce1 wui5 mou5 lik6
